diagnostics.name: case-bound-by-name
diagnostics.message: `loans#renew-limit` is active, and the tag at tests/loans.test.js:2 binds the case `Loans renews` to the test `renews` by a weak link (cause `by-name`): no full field of a case ties it to the test: the report or the project does not hold the field; make the runner write it (jest-junit: `addFileAttribute: "true"`; pytest: `junit_family = xunit1`; gotestsum: `--junitfile-testcase-classname=relative`), or keep the `Cargo.toml` or `go.mod` above the test file
diagnostics.fix: A `covers:` tag has a weak bind: no full identity ties the case to the test, or the identity is not unique. The bind counts, and the worst of all its cases decides, but a case of another test can take the place of the case of the test. The message names the cause. `by-name`: make the runner write the field that names the test file (jest-junit: `addFileAttribute: "true"`; pytest: `junit_family = xunit1`; gotestsum: `--junitfile-testcase-classname=relative`), or keep the `Cargo.toml` or `go.mod` above the test file. `not-unique`: rename one of the tests or files, or set the runner so that its report tells them apart. `no-identity`: spec-dna cannot read the layout of the test, so add `case:"<case>"` to the tag if the case is the test under the tag.

diagnostics.name: requirement-unproven
diagnostics.message: `loans#fines` is active, and the tag at tests/test_import.py:1 stands above no test (line 2 is not a test); put the tag on the line above the test, or add `case:"<name>"`
diagnostics.fix: A `covers:` tag names the requirement, and no test case that binds to the tag passed in the report. Make the test run and pass. Put the tag above the test, or add `case:<name>` to the tag. As an alternative, add `<!-- verified-by: <path> -->` for a check by a person.
